assertions.name: production_link_is_linear_chain
assertions.source: production atom_braid_word_3A places A−1 inter-nucleon bonds (linear chain): M_2=A−1, M_3=μ̄_123=0; undershoots (open 9b coordination gap).

description: EXPLORATORY: the production canonical braid (atom_braid_word_3A) is a linear chain with A−1 inter-nucleon bonds (4He=3,6Li=5,12C=11, verified). Milnor: M_2=A−1 (chain linking), M_3=μ̄_123=0 (chain reducible to pairwise). This is the chain model that undershoots — the open 9b coordination gap. The compact canonical link (coordination≈3, μ̄_123≠0 Borromean 3-body) is the open problem.
